data.title: Barcelona reach deal with Man City to sign Rodri
data.description: BARCELONA - Barcelona have reached a deal with Manchester City to sign Spanish World Cup winner Rodri, a source from the Catalan club told AFP Sunday.

data.title: Records for Asher-Smith, Hunt as Britain win 4x100m mixed relay
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Amy Hunt bagged a record fourth gold at the European championships on Sunday as part of the winning British quartet in the 4x100m mixed relay.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo rules out more kickboxing ‘side fights’ unless title is at stake
data.description: Nico Carrillo has ruled out taking any more kickboxing “side fights” in ONE Championship unless a world title is at stake, with the Scot now focused on securing his first defence of the featherweight Muay Thai belt.

data.title: Pornpun to lead Thai side bidding for LA 2028 spot
data.description: <p>The Thailand Volleyball Association (TVA) has announced a 14-player roster for the 2026 AVC Women's Volleyball Continental Championship in China.</p>

data.title: Liverpool sell minority stake to Jeff Bezos consortium
data.description: LONDON - Liverpool's owners have agreed to sell a minority stake in the Premier League club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

data.title: Arpichaya in lead at Portland LPGA event
data.description: PORTLAND, Oregon - Thailand’s Arpichaya Yubol, ​in search of ⁠her first ⁠LPGA tournament win, holds ​a one-shot lead midway through the Standard Portland Classic.

data.title: Thailand, Wada seek closer cooperation
data.description: Thailand is working to strengthen its anti-doping system in line with international standards and deepen cooperation with the World Anti-Doping Agency (Wada).

data.title: Dreams, drama and dread: 72 clubs begin the promotion battle
data.description: <p>Although the Premier League does not kick off until next week, the English football season really gets under way this weekend as the 72 clubs in the Championship, League One and League Two begin their new campaigns. We've already had the opening round of the Carabao League Cup, which, probably, served as a useful warm up for managers and players alike.</p>

data.title: Lions stand in War Elephants' way
data.description: <p>Seven-time champions Thailand will take on Singapore in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-finals on Saturday night in a clash between two nations that boast a combined 11 regional titles in the tournament's 30-year history.</p>

data.title: Premier League club Liverpool sell minority stake to Jeff Bezos consortium
data.description: LONDON - Liverpool's owners have agreed to sell a minority stake in the Premier League club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil Anane launches Thailand Olympic boxing bid – but must earn LA28 spot
data.description: ONE Championship will support Nabil Anane’s attempt to earn a place in Thailand’s boxing team for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics – but the promotion’s former bantamweight Muay Thai champion will not be fast-tracked into the national squad.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nontachai ruled out with illness as Nabati fight is scrapped
data.description: Kiamran Nabati’s ONE Fight Night 46 bout with Nontachai Jitmuangnon was scrapped on Thursday after the Thai fell ill, went to hospital and did not receive medical clearance.

data.title: Hunt bags Euro sprint double, Ceh keeps discus title
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Briton Amy Hunt claimed a memorable European sprint double after scorching to victory in the 200m in Birmingham on Thursday on a night when Germany claimed five medals, including two golds.

data.title: Fit Patrik ready to fire War Elephants
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson welcomed the addition of striker Patrik Gustavsson, saying the BG Pathum United star will give the team an attacking option in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-finals on Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kiamran Nabati reveals dengue scare before first loss, wants Yod-IQ rematch for title
data.description: Kiamran Nabati wants Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri to dethrone ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai king Rambolek – and give him the chance to avenge his first career defeat with the title at stake.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo tells Tom Keogh ‘back of the line’ after title call-out
data.description: Nico Carrillo has dismissed rising Irish prospect Tom Keogh as “another dreamer” and told him to go to the “back of the line” after his ONE Championship title call-out.

data.title: Messi returns but Miami knocked out of Leagues Cup
data.description: MIAMI - Lionel Messi made an emotional return on Wednesday following his father’s death and hints at retirement, but it wasn’t enough for his Inter Miami side who were knocked out of the Leagues Cup in a 3-2 loss to Mexico’s Leon.

data.title: Grieving Messi unsure about playing on 'much longer'
data.description: BUENOS AIRES - Lionel Messi said he has "serious doubts" about continuing to play football for "much longer" after the death of his father Jorge, in an emotional tribute posted on social media Wednesday.

data.title: Grieving Argentine icon Messi unsure about playing on 'much longer'
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Lionel Messi said he has "serious doubts" about continuing to play football for "much longer" after the death of his father Jorge, in an emotional tribute posted on social media Wednesday.

data.title: Thai champs handed Pot 1 seeding for ACL draw
data.description: Buriram United have been placed in Pot 1 for the Eastern Zone of the AFC Champions League Elite, the Asian Football Confederation confirmed, ahead of an official draw on Aug 18 that will shape the continent's premier club competition.
